tagline: Multiplexed fluorescent stress biosensors in yeast plus a machine-learning layer that turns intracellular stress into the next experiment to run.
tagline_zh: 在酵母中建立多工螢光壓力生物感測器，再加上一層機器學習，把細胞內的壓力狀態轉換成下一個該做的實驗。
summary: Industrial bioreactors hold hundreds of thousands of litres and a single bad batch is expensive, yet conventional monitoring tracks only physical and chemical parameters such as pH and dissolved oxygen — nothing about what is happening inside the cell. Omics and LC-MS can see inside, but they are offline, destructive and slow enough that results arrive after the batch has finished, so they cannot act on anything. ORCHID puts biosensors for endoplasmic reticulum, oxidative and ATP stress into Saccharomyces cerevisiae as fluorescent reporters readable straight from a plate reader, solves the resulting spectral overlap with a linear unmixing model, and feeds the separated stress signals into SABLe, a neural-network framework that predicts growth, product and stress from process conditions and then proposes which culture to run next. It won nominations across parts, presentation, wiki and integrated human practices because the loop actually closed: SABLe's exploration rule proposed 27 C, the team grew that plate, and the measured product signal reached 491 mApple RFU/OD600 against 204 and 179 at the 24 and 30 C conditions it was trained on.
summary_zh: 工業級生物反應器動輒數十萬公升，一批壞掉就所費不菲，然而常規監測只追蹤 pH 與溶氧這類物理化學參數，對細胞內部正在發生什麼完全無法掌握。體學分析與 LC-MS 看得到內部，但它們是離線、破壞性的，而且慢到結果在批次結束後才拿到，因此無法據以採取任何行動。ORCHID 把偵測內質網壓力、氧化壓力與 ATP 壓力的生物感測器以螢光報導子的形式放進 Saccharomyces cerevisiae，可直接用盤式讀取儀讀取，再以一個線性解混模型處理隨之而來的光譜重疊，並把分離出來的壓力訊號餵給 SABLe，一個由製程條件預測生長、產物與壓力、並進而提議下一盤該培養什麼條件的類神經網路框架。本案在零件、簡報、wiki 與整合式人類實踐多項入圍，因為這個迴圈真的閉合了：SABLe 的探索規則提議 27 C，團隊真的培養了那一盤，而量到的產物訊號達到 491 mApple RFU/OD600，相對於訓練資料中 24 C 與 30 C 條件下的 204 與 179。

dry.frameworks: Three layers, built in sequence. First, a linear unmixing model adapted from multispectral fluorescence imaging to plate-reader wells: each sample's readings are modelled as a mixture matrix with one column per reporter and one row per channel, with diagonal entries carrying a reporter's own signal and off-diagonal entries the crosstalk, inverted to recover each reporter's share. It was validated on mixtures of single-reporter strains including untransformed BY4741 for autofluorescence and water-only wells for background, six replicates per condition. Second, a mechanistic baseline: Hill dose-response curves fitted at each temperature for DTT against the stress reporter and galactose against the product reporter, plus simple ODE time-course equations. The ODEs tracked growth well (R-squared about 0.91-0.93) but fitted stress (0.33-0.47) and product (0.41-0.42) poorly, and the team uses that failure as the explicit justification for moving to machine learning rather than assuming ML was needed. Third, SABLe: a multilayer perceptron trained on 700 culture-time records from 40 unique condition combinations (two temperatures at 24 and 30 C, five DTT concentrations 0-1 mM, four galactose concentrations 0-0.2%, three independent plate cultures each, measured at 0, 3, 5, 7, 9 and 24-26 hours), predicting OD600, mApple/OD600 and mCitrine/OD600 without ever receiving their measured values as inputs. On top of the trained network they run gradient ascent (network frozen, 64 starting conditions, 500 steps each, 32,000 evaluations without growing a culture), a ten-member bootstrap ensemble for disagreement-based uncertainty, and UMAP projection of the 64-dimensional latent response to 20,000 queried conditions to inspect what the network learned.
dry.frameworks_zh: 三層架構，依序建起。第一層是一個線性解混模型，由多光譜螢光影像的做法改寫套用到盤式讀取儀的反應孔上：每個樣本的讀值都被建模為一個混合矩陣，每個報導子一欄、每個偵測通道一列，對角元素承載該報導子自身的訊號、非對角元素則是串訊，再透過求逆還原出每個報導子的占比。它以單一報導子菌株的混合物驗證，包含以未轉形的 BY4741 作為自體螢光對照、以純水孔作為背景，每個條件六個重複。第二層是機制基準線：在每個溫度下分別擬合 DTT 對壓力報導子、半乳糖對產物報導子的 Hill 劑量反應曲線，再加上簡單的 ODE 時間歷程方程式。這些 ODE 把生長追蹤得不錯（R 平方約 0.91 至 0.93），但對壓力（0.33 至 0.47）與產物（0.41 至 0.42）的擬合很差，而團隊正是以這個失敗作為轉向機器學習的明確理由，而不是先假設非用機器學習不可。第三層是 SABLe：一個多層感知器，以 40 種獨特條件組合下的 700 筆培養時間點紀錄訓練（兩個溫度 24 與 30 C、五種 DTT 濃度 0 至 1 mM、四種半乳糖濃度 0 至 0.2%，每種條件三盤獨立培養，於 0、3、5、7、9 與 24 至 26 小時量測），預測 OD600、mApple/OD600 與 mCitrine/OD600，而這些量測值從未作為輸入餵給它。在訓練好的網路之上，他們執行梯度上升（網路凍結、64 個起始條件、各 500 步，共 32,000 次評估而不必培養任何一盤細胞）、一個十成員的 bootstrap 集成以取得基於不一致的不確定性，以及對 20,000 個查詢條件的 64 維潛在響應做 UMAP 投影，以檢視網路到底學到了什麼。
dry.dataviz: The wiki is a Three.js scrollytelling experience that walks a reader from the $2-4 trillion bioeconomy projection down to a single yeast cell, with hoverable bioreactors explaining Titer, Rate and Yield before the project is even introduced — the argument is built visually before any data appears. The dry lab page is laid out as a numbered slide sequence (raw extremes, normalisation, normalised trajectories, stress dose fit, product dose fit, time model fit, fivefold split, held-out scores, held-out trajectories, gradient search, ensemble uncertainty, exploration score, optimisation versus exploration, latent UMAP, measured DTT response, UMAP robustness), so the reasoning chain is the navigation. Two choices stand out. The exploit-versus-explore panel shows side by side that maximising predicted signal just returns to a corner already measured, while the exploration rule spreads eight proposed tests across under-sampled combinations — making the value of the method visible rather than argued. And the UMAP is drawn sixteen different ways with the caption telling the reader to compare colour gradients rather than outlines, with an explicit note that the map axes have no biological units, which is an honest treatment of a technique usually presented as if its shape meant something.
dry.dataviz_zh: 這個 wiki 是一段 Three.js 捲動敘事，帶著讀者從 2 至 4 兆美元的生物經濟規模預測，一路下降到單一個酵母細胞，途中可滑過的生物反應器會解釋效價、速率與產率，而這一切都發生在專案本身被介紹之前，也就是論證先以視覺建立，資料才出現。乾實驗頁面編排成一連串有編號的投影片（原始極端值、歸一化、歸一化後的軌跡、壓力劑量擬合、產物劑量擬合、時間模型擬合、五折切分、保留測試分數、保留測試軌跡、梯度搜尋、集成不確定性、探索分數、最佳化對探索、潛在空間 UMAP、實測 DTT 反應、UMAP 穩健性），因此推理鏈本身就是導覽結構。其中兩個選擇特別突出。利用對探索的面板並排顯示：單純最大化預測訊號只會回到一個已經量過的角落，而探索規則則把八個提議的測試散布到取樣不足的組合上，讓這套方法的價值變成看得見的，而不是用說的。另外，UMAP 以十六種不同方式繪製，而圖說告訴讀者要比較的是顏色梯度而不是輪廓，並明確註明圖的座標軸沒有生物學單位，這對一項常被呈現得好像其形狀自有意義的技術而言，是相當誠實的處理。
dry.datascience: The statistical discipline here is well above the usual standard. Cross-validation groups all biological replicates and time points from a single cultivation condition into one split, because splitting correlated measurements across train and test would inflate performance — so the reported scores (R-squared 0.955 for OD600, 0.891 for mApple/OD600, 0.842 for mCitrine/OD600) measure generalisation to genuinely unseen condition combinations. Channel selection asked how few reads are needed and found one well-chosen channel per reporter matches a full spectral scan (three channels as good as six for three reporters, four as good as eight for four), turning an hour-long scan into minutes so a bioreactor can be sampled routinely. A simulation study set the design rule for adding reporters: for each separation angle from 2 to 90 degrees they generated 3,000 random two-reporter mixtures with 5% noise and found median error stays within 5 percentage points once reporters are at least 28 degrees apart — which is why mCitrine and eGFP at 20 degrees are ruled out. Errors are diagnosed rather than reported: the consistent 3-point overestimate of mTurquoise2 and underestimate of mApple in three-reporter mixtures is attributed to sample preparation rather than the algorithm because noise alone would scatter in both directions, and the larger four-reporter errors are traced to the whole plate being 6-17 times dimmer, leaving mApple and mTurquoise2 only about 160 and 690 RFU above water. Then the model generated a biological hypothesis: UMAP showed conditions with more DTT clustering where both stress and product are predicted high (79% of high-predicted-product conditions were also high DTT, 81% high predicted stress, against 25% expected by chance), the team went back to the measured cultures and confirmed it (Spearman rho, p < 0.001), checked that mCitrine bleed into the mApple channel could explain at most 8% of the rise, and named the next mechanistic question. They also caught their own education-survey analogue of this problem in the model: the 27 C validation plate was read at 24 hours while earlier plates were read at about 25, and they say so.
dry.datascience_zh: 這裡的統計紀律明顯高於一般水準。交叉驗證把來自同一培養條件的所有生物重複與時間點全部歸進同一折，因為把彼此相關的量測分散到訓練與測試集會虛增表現，因此回報的分數（OD600 的 R 平方 0.955、mApple/OD600 的 0.891、mCitrine/OD600 的 0.842）量到的是對真正沒見過的條件組合的泛化能力。通道選擇要回答的是最少需要讀幾個通道，結果發現每個報導子只要一個選得好的通道，就能比得上完整光譜掃描（三個報導子用三通道與六通道一樣好，四個報導子用四通道與八通道一樣好），把一小時的掃描縮短到幾分鐘，使生物反應器可以常規取樣。一項模擬研究則訂出了增加報導子的設計準則：對 2 至 90 度的每一個分離角度，他們生成 3,000 組帶 5% 雜訊的隨機雙報導子混合物，發現只要報導子相距至少 28 度，誤差中位數就能維持在 5 個百分點以內，而這正是相距 20 度的 mCitrine 與 eGFP 被排除的原因。誤差是被診斷而不是只被回報：三報導子混合物中 mTurquoise2 一致高估約 3 個百分點、mApple 一致低估，被歸因於樣本製備而不是演算法，因為單純的雜訊會往兩個方向散開；而四報導子時較大的誤差則追溯到整盤亮度低了 6 至 17 倍，使 mApple 與 mTurquoise2 分別只比純水高出約 160 與 690 RFU。接著模型產生了一個生物學假說：UMAP 顯示 DTT 較高的條件會聚集在壓力與產物都被預測為高的區域（預測產物高的條件中有 79% 同時是高 DTT、81% 是高預測壓力，而隨機期望值為 25%），團隊回頭檢視實測的培養結果並予以確認（Spearman rho，p < 0.001），也核算過 mCitrine 溢漏到 mApple 通道最多只能解釋其中 8% 的上升，並點出下一個機制層面的問題。他們也在模型中抓到自己在教育問卷裡同類型的問題：27 C 的驗證盤是在 24 小時讀取，而先前的盤是在約 25 小時讀取，而他們把這件事說了出來。
dry.software: SABLe and the linear unmixing algorithm are released on the iGEM GitLab at https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/nus-singapore/model, framed explicitly as a reusable framework rather than a one-project script — future teams can use the unmixing to quantify several fluorescent proteins at once and track multiple cellular processes from a single strain design. The part collection is the other deliverable: 17 modular basic parts (stress-sensing elements including altered and native Yap1 response elements, UPRE1 and UPRE2 Hac1 binding sites, biosensor tuning elements, promoters of differing strengths, terminators, and fluorescent reporters including a genetically encoded green ATP sensor) plus 12 composite parts for the ER, oxidative and ATP stress biosensors, designed for plug-and-play assembly. They also characterised leakiness-reduction design principles as a reusable pattern: Sko1 repression upstream of the TATA box, a cP_CYC1 core promoter to lower basal expression, an ODC degradation tag for continuous turnover of background protein, and an RPP2Bt terminator. Two education artefacts are software: a browser game in which players build genetic circuits in virtual yeast populations, with every number and equation documented by source category (published, game-balance tuned by scripted playtesting, or stated rule) and an honest statement that no value was fitted to a real culture so the game shows the shape of the biology rather than predictions; and SynVision, an app whose camera scanner links everyday objects to synthetic biology concepts and then runs DBTL-guided questioning.
dry.software_zh: SABLe 與線性解混演算法釋出於 iGEM GitLab（https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/nus-singapore/model），並明確定位為一個可重複使用的框架而非單一專案的腳本：未來的團隊可以用這套解混法同時定量數種螢光蛋白，並從單一菌株設計中追蹤多個細胞程序。零件集是另一項交付成果：17 個模組化基礎零件（壓力感測元件，包含經改造與原生的 Yap1 反應元件、UPRE1 與 UPRE2 的 Hac1 結合位、生物感測器調校元件、強度各異的啟動子、終止子，以及含一個基因編碼綠色 ATP 感測器的螢光報導子），加上 12 個用於內質網、氧化與 ATP 壓力生物感測器的複合零件，全部為隨插即用式組裝而設計。他們也把降低滲漏表現的設計原則整理成一個可重複使用的模式：TATA 盒上游的 Sko1 抑制、以 cP_CYC1 核心啟動子降低基礎表現量、以 ODC 降解標籤讓背景蛋白質持續被代謝掉，以及一個 RPP2Bt 終止子。兩項教育產出也是軟體：一款瀏覽器遊戲，玩家在虛擬酵母族群中建構基因迴路，其中每一個數值與方程式都依來源類別標註（已發表、以腳本化試玩調整遊戲平衡，或明訂規則），並誠實聲明沒有任何數值是擬合到真實培養資料上的，因此遊戲呈現的是生物學的形狀而不是預測；以及 SynVision，一款以相機掃描把日常物件連結到合成生物學概念、再進行 DBTL 導引式提問的應用程式。
stack: Gradient ascent over a frozen network
Linear unmixing / matrix inversion on plate-reader channels
Microsoft Forms with anonymous participant linking codes
techniques: Multiplexed fluorescent biosensing with spectral deconvolution
Reference-spectra calibration including autofluorescence and background wells
Condition-grouped cross-validation to prevent leakage from correlated replicates
Channel-subset selection to minimise readout time
Bootstrap ensemble disagreement as an uncertainty proxy
Exploit-versus-explore acquisition scoring (normalised disagreement plus distance to nearest tested condition)
Latent-space projection to generate testable biological hypotheses
Model-proposed condition validated at the bench
Systematic error diagnosis distinguishing preparation artefacts from algorithm error

good.publicEngagement: NUS treated their educational game as a research object, which is rare at any level. It was designed against Self-Determination Theory with autonomy, competence and relatedness mapped to specific mechanics (free choice of parts, a shared leaderboard, facilitated peer discussion), and every simulation value published with its provenance. Evaluation used paired pre- and post-surveys via Microsoft Forms where participants generated the same anonymous linking code on both forms from details only they would know, so before-and-after answers could be matched without collecting names or emails. They deployed across six settings — Project STEMpact Workshop 3 with secondary school students, NCEB Engineering Biology Week FUTURES Day with polytechnic students, two undergraduate modules (SP2718C and BN4501), NUS Telegram channels and a Raffles Girls' School email blast — getting 58 pre-surveys and 27 post-surveys between 5 September and 18 October 2026, of which 24 paired. The analysis is where it becomes exemplary: four Intrinsic Motivation Inventory subscales were shortened and reworded, then checked for internal consistency with Cronbach's alpha in their own data, which exposed that Perceived Choice at alpha 0.23 was not a single construct (its two items measured having choices and feeling obliged to play) so they reported them separately instead of averaging. Three items were negatively worded and reverse-scored to catch acquiescent responders. Attrition bias was tested — only 41% of pre-survey takers paired — and no item differed (all p > .18). Self-ratings on all three understanding statements rose 1.3-1.8 points (d = 0.76-0.95) and intent to pursue synthetic biology from 4.0 to 4.9 (d = 0.64), all surviving Holm correction. But they also scored free-text definitions as an independent check: promoters rose from 64% to 91% correct, sensors from 23% to 45%, genes stayed at 55%, and the overall written score moved only 1.4 to 1.9 out of 3 (p = .06). Crucially, self-ratings matched written answers before playing (rho = .65) and did not afterwards (rho = -.04) — participants felt they understood more than they could explain — so the team explicitly treats the self-reported gains as an upper bound. Their own headline finding is that participants valued the game more than they enjoyed it: the highest-rated statement in the survey was that the game is useful for understanding synthetic biology (5.5) and the lowest was about enjoying it while playing (4.3).
good.publicEngagement_zh: NUS 把自己的教育遊戲當成研究對象來處理，這在任何層級都很罕見。遊戲依自我決定論設計，把自主性、能力感與關聯感對應到具體機制（自由挑選零件、共用排行榜、經引導的同儕討論），而每一個模擬數值都連同其出處一併公開。評估採用透過 Microsoft Forms 進行的前後測配對問卷，參與者在兩份表單上以只有自己知道的資訊生成相同的匿名連結碼，因此前後作答能夠配對，卻不必蒐集姓名或電子郵件。他們在六個場域施行，包括與中學生進行的 Project STEMpact Workshop 3、與技職學院學生進行的 NCEB Engineering Biology Week FUTURES Day、兩門大學課程（SP2718C 與 BN4501）、NUS 的 Telegram 頻道，以及一次 Raffles Girls' School 的電子郵件群發；在 2026 年 9 月 5 日至 10 月 18 日之間收到 58 份前測與 27 份後測，其中 24 份成功配對。真正堪為典範的是分析本身：四個內在動機量表（IMI）分量表經縮短與改寫後，他們以自己的資料計算 Cronbach's alpha 檢查內部一致性，結果暴露出「知覺選擇感」的 alpha 只有 0.23，並不是單一構念（其兩題分別量到「有選擇」與「覺得被迫玩」），因此他們分開回報而不是取平均。另有三題以負向措辭並反向計分，用以抓出有默認作答傾向的受訪者。流失偏誤也經過檢定，前測受訪者中只有 41% 成功配對，而沒有任何一題出現差異（全部 p > .18）。三項理解程度的自評都上升 1.3 至 1.8 分（d = 0.76 至 0.95），而投入合成生物學的意願由 4.0 升至 4.9（d = 0.64），全部通過 Holm 校正。但他們也對開放式定義作答評分作為獨立檢核：啟動子由 64% 正確升至 91%、感測器由 23% 升至 45%、基因維持在 55%，而整體書面分數在 3 分制下僅由 1.4 移動到 1.9（p = .06）。關鍵在於，自評在玩之前與書面作答一致（rho = .65），玩過之後則不再一致（rho = -.04），也就是參與者自覺理解的比他們能解釋的更多，因此團隊明確把自陳的進步視為上限。他們自己的頭條發現是，參與者對這款遊戲的評價高於他們玩得開心的程度：問卷中評分最高的敘述是「這款遊戲對理解合成生物學有幫助」（5.5），最低的則是關於玩的時候是否享受（4.3）。
good.ihp: The project's scope was set and then substantially narrowed by stakeholders. An application scientist at TJX Bioengineering established that a single failed batch causes substantial financial loss and shifted the team's attention from the product to the production process and the changing conditions cells experience; Anomaly Bio, a precision fermentation startup, established that conventional monitoring tracks physical and chemical parameters while the cell's inner workings are overlooked because they are hard to measure and hard to interpret. The largest single change came from Dr Bruce Li, Alan Yang and Prof Yong-Su Jin raising scale-up challenges, deployment barriers and startup resource constraints: in response the team moved ORCHID's primary intended application from continuous industrial monitoring to early-stage R&D, naming strain-engineering and process-development teams at startups as the primary users and dropping production-scale deployment as an immediate objective. Several design elements are individually attributable — Dr Jee Loon Foo's guidance set the initial oxidative and ER stress targets, Sheena Chan's feedback added the ATP depletion sensor, and Dr Bruce Li's concerns about whether the biosensors themselves perturb the cell led them to build parental-versus-biosensor-strain comparisons into the experimental design. Sook Wei explained how genome-scale metabolic models represent competition between growth and product formation but warned that conventional metabolic models may not match real cellular behaviour because of unaccounted byproducts, competing pathways and biological constraints, stressing that experimental data is what closes that gap and pointing toward combining genome-scale modelling with machine learning — advice visible in the final architecture, where a mechanistic ODE baseline is fitted first, shown to fail on stress and product, and only then replaced by a learned model. Later feedback also asked them to extend the model to weigh productivity, yield and cost together rather than optimising a single predicted output, which is recorded as future work rather than claimed as done.
good.ihp_zh: 專案的範圍是由利害關係人定下來、並且被他們大幅收窄的。TJX Bioengineering 的一位應用科學家確立了「一批失敗就造成重大財務損失」這件事，使團隊的注意力由產物轉向生產製程以及細胞所經歷的變動條件；精準發酵新創 Anomaly Bio 則確立了常規監測只追蹤物理與化學參數，而細胞內部運作之所以被忽略，是因為既難量測也難解讀。最大的單一改變來自 Dr Bruce Li、Alan Yang 與 Prof Yong-Su Jin 提出的放大量產挑戰、部署障礙與新創資源限制：團隊因此把 ORCHID 的主要預期應用從連續性的工業監測改為早期研發階段，指名新創公司的菌株工程與製程開發團隊為主要使用者，並放棄把量產規模部署當成立即目標。有幾項設計元素可以逐一歸因：Dr Jee Loon Foo 的指引定下了最初的氧化壓力與內質網壓力標的；Sheena Chan 的回饋加入了 ATP 耗竭感測器；而 Dr Bruce Li 關於「生物感測器本身是否會干擾細胞」的疑慮，使他們把親代菌株與生物感測器菌株的比較納入實驗設計。Sook Wei 說明了基因組尺度代謝模型如何表徵生長與產物形成之間的競爭，但也提醒傳統代謝模型可能與真實的細胞行為不符，原因是未納入計算的副產物、競爭途徑與生物學上的限制，並強調實驗資料才是填補那個落差的東西，同時指出把基因組尺度建模與機器學習結合的方向；這項建議在最終架構中看得見，也就是先擬合一條機制性的 ODE 基準線、指出它在壓力與產物上失效，然後才以學習而來的模型取代它。後續的回饋也要求他們把模型擴充成同時權衡生產力、產率與成本，而不是只最佳化單一預測輸出，而這一點被記錄為未來工作，沒有被當成已完成來宣稱。
good.realWorld: The deployment story is deliberately modest after the industry reality check. ORCHID is positioned as an early-stage R&D platform for strain engineering and process development teams at startups, not as production-scale instrumentation, because the team accepted that industrial implementation carries technical and financial constraints they cannot yet meet. The workflow they specify is concrete: build or adopt modular biosensors for the analytes of interest in whatever chassis is being engineered, culture under varied process conditions, train the model on how conditions map to stress responses, use it to interpolate and recommend conditions, then run the organism under those conditions — with the intracellular data also making unintended effects on the host easier to spot. The framing they use for the value proposition is a grey box rather than a black box: in-line pH and dissolved oxygen sensors show how organism and environment affect each other, but when production is inefficient researchers still cannot tell which pathway is the constraint, and high-dimensional intracellular stress data gives a window into that. Because the biosensors are modular, they argue the collection builds toward a shared library: metabolic engineering teams can track the burden a heterologous pathway places on the cell, and environmental synthetic biology teams can assess strain robustness in harsh conditions. Troubleshooting is published as a first-class deliverable, with issues and fixes in segmented boxes down the results page specifically so later teams hit them less hard.
good.realWorld_zh: 經過業界的現實檢驗之後，部署的敘事刻意保持謙抑。ORCHID 被定位為供新創公司菌株工程與製程開發團隊使用的早期研發平台，而不是量產規模的儀器，因為團隊接受了工業落實帶有他們目前還做不到的技術與財務限制。他們所指定的工作流程相當具體：在正在改造的任何底盤中，針對關注的分析標的建立或採用模組化生物感測器，在不同製程條件下培養，用這些資料訓練模型學會條件如何對應到壓力反應，再用它內插並推薦條件，然後在那些條件下實際培養該生物；而細胞內的資料也讓宿主身上非預期的影響更容易被發現。他們用來談價值主張的框架是「灰箱」而不是「黑箱」：線上的 pH 與溶氧感測器能顯示生物與環境如何互相影響，但當生產效率不佳時，研究人員仍然無法判斷到底是哪一條途徑成為瓶頸，而高維度的細胞內壓力資料正好提供了那扇窗。由於這些生物感測器是模組化的，他們主張整個零件集會累積成一座共享資料庫：代謝工程團隊可以追蹤一條異源途徑對細胞造成多少負擔，而環境合成生物學團隊則可以評估菌株在嚴苛條件下的穩健性。疑難排解被當成第一級的交付成果公開，問題與解法以分段方塊的形式沿著結果頁面排列，明確就是為了讓後續團隊少踩一些坑。
partners: TJX Bioengineering (application scientist, cell culture bioprocess)

gemsTakeaway: Two things are directly copyable and neither needs a bioreactor. First, NUS's active-learning loop: fit a simple mechanistic model, show where it fails, train a small neural net on your own plate data, then use ensemble disagreement plus distance from tested conditions to pick the next experiment — and actually run it, so the write-up ends with a measured confirmation rather than a prediction. Second, and more unusual, evaluate your outreach the way you evaluate an assay: paired pre/post surveys with anonymous linking codes, reverse-scored items to catch acquiescence, Cronbach's alpha on any scale you shorten, attrition checks, and a free-text knowledge score as an independent check on self-reports. NUS found their participants felt they had learned more than they could explain, and said so — that kind of honesty about one's own teaching is both rare and cheap to adopt.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 有兩件事可以直接照抄，而且都不需要生物反應器。第一是 NUS 的主動學習迴圈：先擬合一個簡單的機制模型，指出它在哪裡失效，再用自己盤上的資料訓練一個小型類神經網路，然後以集成模型之間的不一致加上與已測試條件的距離來挑下一個實驗，而且真的去把它做出來，讓整份報告以一次實測確認收尾，而不是以一個預測收尾。第二件更少見：請用評估一項檢定的方式來評估你的科普推廣，也就是以匿名連結碼配對的前後測問卷、用反向計分題抓出默認作答傾向、對任何被你縮短的量表計算 Cronbach's alpha、做流失偏誤檢查，並以開放式作答的知識評分作為自評結果的獨立檢核。NUS 發現他們的參與者自覺學到的比實際能解釋的更多，而且他們把這件事說了出來。這種對自身教學成效的誠實既罕見，採用的成本也極低。
